ideas.pitch: A standalone interactive browser extension and parser that steps through complex graph and dynamic programming solutions line by line, visualizing the state transitions and memory allocations during execution.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer & Debugger Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at competitive programmers participating in the Tech Zephyr 4.0 CP Contest, offering immediate utility for analyzing complex algorithms during or after the contest.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning model trained on competitive programming submissions that predicts whether a given Python or C++ solution will pass time and memory limits based on its abstract syntax tree and loop structures.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuine algorithmic engineering and technical depth, aligning with patterns seen in winning submissions that solve hard technical challenges.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent companion tool that analyzes a coder's submission history on GFG and CodeForces, identifies weak algorithmic patterns, and automatically curates a personalized upsolving list with hints instead of full solutions.
ideas.title: CodeForces/GFG Upsolving Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides high utility for the exact demographic of competitive programming students participating in this individual contest format.

ideas.pitch: A real-time 1v1 coding sandbox allowing solo participants to challenge peers to rapid 15-minute problem-solving sprints with automated test case evaluation.
ideas.title: CP Duel Matchmaking Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Enhances the competitive programming experience of the contest by adding a live interactive sparring feature that appeals to participants wanting extra practice.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool for competitive programmers that quickly generates randomized edge cases and compares a slow brute-force solution against an optimized solution to catch edge-case bugs before submission.
ideas.title: Contest Stress-Tester CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, highly practical pain point for solo developers participating in fast-paced timed coding contests.
